::: {#exr-sample-likelihood}
#### Likelihood of the dataset

Write down the likelihood of the full dataset.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-sample-likelihood}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Lik(\rate; \vx)
&\eqdef \Pr(\vX = \vx)
&& \text{(definition of likelihood)}\\
&= \Pr(X_1 = x_1, X_2 = x_2, \ldots, X_{13} = x_{13})
&& \text{(write out the vector)}\\
&= \prod_{i=1}^{13} \Pr(\Rvar_\iobs = \rvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(independence)}\\
&= \prod_{i=1}^{13} \frac{\rate^{\rvar_\iobs} e^{-\rate}}{\rvar_\iobs!}
&& \text{(Poisson PMF)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
